question: Which of the following is the highest gravity dam in India?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __Bhakra Dam.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bhakra Dam is the highest straight gravity dam in India.
 
• It is around 226 m high and 518 m long.
 
• Bhakra dam is constructed on Satluj river and located in Himachal Pradesh and Punjab border near Nangal city.
